definitions.explanation: To pour water over oneself; to take a shower.

definitions.gloss: to be exposed to, to bask in
definitions.explanation: To be covered by or exposed to something like light or attention.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}シャワーを{浴|あ}びてから{会社|かいしゃ}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: I take a shower in the morning before going to work.

notes:
{浴|あ}びる is used for showering and being exposed to things.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- シャワーを{浴|あ}びる (take a shower)
- {日光|にっこう}を{浴|あ}びる (bask in sunlight)
- {注目|ちゅうもく}を{浴|あ}びる (attract attention)
- {批判|ひはん}を{浴|あ}びる (receive criticism)

NOTE: Different from {入|はい}る (お{風呂|ふろ}に{入|はい}る - to take a bath).
